name: developer-intelligence
description: Local-first commit telemetry and transparency for DevHouse

devintel.supabaseUrl.markdownDescription: **DEPRECATED - DO NOT USE**: Supabase credentials are now stored securely. Use `DevHouse: Configure Supabase Credentials` command instead. This setting is only checked for migration purposes.
devintel.supabaseUrl.deprecationMessage: Use 'DevHouse: Configure Supabase Credentials' command instead. Credentials are now stored in secure storage.

devintel.supabaseKey.markdownDescription: **DEPRECATED - DO NOT USE**: Supabase credentials are now stored securely. Use `DevHouse: Configure Supabase Credentials` command instead. This setting is only checked for migration purposes.
devintel.supabaseKey.deprecationMessage: Use 'DevHouse: Configure Supabase Credentials' command instead. Credentials are now stored in secure storage.

devintel.developerId.description: Optional. Developer identifier attached to commit events. Leave blank to use your local OS username.

devintel.repositoryName.description: Optional. Fallback repository name used only when Git metadata cannot provide one.

devintel.telemetryEnabled.markdownDescription: Optional. Default: enabled. Allows DevHouse to prepare and upload commit telemetry on commit events. When disabled, DevHouse stays local-only and no commit uploads are prepared.

devintel.presenceEnabled.markdownDescription: Optional. Default: **disabled**. Allows local webcam presence checks for the current session. **Requires explicit consent on first use**. Raw camera frames are **not** uploaded; only summary counts can be attached to a commit event when commit upload is enabled and configured.

devintel.backgroundMonitoringEnabled.markdownDescription: Optional. Default: enabled. Allows local tracking of **whitelisted** background applications for the current session. Only app names and time-seen summaries can be attached to a commit event when commit upload is enabled and configured.

devintel.showStatusBarSummary.markdownDescription: Optional. Default: enabled. Shows a compact DevHouse summary in the VS Code status bar. Clicking it opens the transparency center.

devintel.pythonCommand.description: Optional. Python launcher used for local presence checks, for example 'py' or 'python'. Leave blank to auto-detect.
